title: Purple Cactus
body:
Description

The Purple Cactus is a tree-type material rarely found on the ground of the desert and more commonly found on top of the sandstone pillars in the desert. Its appearance is a purple cactus texture, and its sanded wood is a light-lavender with no texture. It sells for nearly the same price as the Mushrooms found in Uncertainty Cave.

Like the common cactus, it could sometimes produce Red Flowers that could be sold raw or processed into a Jar using the Dye Machine.

Purple Cacti can be accessed by crossing the arches through the desert peaks.

Trivia

  • Purple Cacti exist in real life also: some cactus species turn purple when they're stressed.
  • The Purple Cactus sells for more than its green counterpart.
